readerCopy.body: Nostalgia can make an old pattern feel more beautiful than it was to live through. Neptune conjunct the South Node can blur the line between meaningful memory and selective memory, especially around a person, dream, role, or chapter you once wanted badly. You may remember the promise and forget the daily cost. The feeling can still tell you something important about what mattered. Just do not use longing as evidence that the old arrangement should be restored exactly as it was.
